data.name: Landlords_FaqSubtitle
data.value: Everything you need to know about listing on Rent.ca.

data.name: Landlords_FaqQ1
data.value: How much does it cost to list?

data.name: Landlords_FaqA1
data.value: We offer three tiers: Limited (free), Promoted ($35 per 15 days), and Featured ($199 per 15 days). All prices in CAD with no contracts.

data.name: Landlords_FaqA2
data.value: Sign up as a landlord, verify your email, and post your first listing in under five minutes. No credit card needed for the free tier.

data.name: Landlords_FaqQ3
data.value: What's included in the free tier?

data.name: Landlords_FaqA3
data.value: The Limited plan includes a basic listing with up to 5 photos, standard search placement, and a contact form for renter inquiries.

data.name: Landlords_FaqQ4
data.value: How does the AI assistant help landlords?

data.name: Landlords_FaqA4
data.value: Our AI assistant recommends your listings to renters who describe what they want in natural language, surfacing your property to genuinely interested matches.

data.name: Landlords_FaqA5
data.value: Yes. Your dashboard lets you manage as many listings as you need from a single account, with per-listing analytics and inbox tracking.

data.name: Landlords_FaqQ6
data.value: How do I upgrade my listing?

data.name: Landlords_FaqA6
data.value: From your dashboard, open the listing and choose Promote or Feature. The upgrade activates immediately and runs for the selected period.

data.name: Landlords_FaqA7
data.value: Rent.ca covers all major Canadian cities including Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Calgary, Ottawa, Edmonton, and 200+ other cities across Canada.

data.name: Landlords_FaqQ8
data.value: How do I cancel my subscription?

data.name: Landlords_FaqA8
data.value: Promoted and Featured plans are pay-as-you-go and don't auto-renew. They expire after 15 days unless you choose to renew. There's nothing to cancel.
